Name: Absolute time
Description: SECONDS_PASSED is the number of seconds that passed from January 1st, year 0 till the current time, in UTC format.

Name: Set-base for relative time
Description: SECONDS_PASSED is ignored, and the time of sending the SET_TIME command with this parameter is set as a reference point.

Name: Relative time
Description: SECONDS_PASSED is the number of seconds that passed since the most recent call to SET_TIME with the parameter RTC_INFO_TYPE(set to 0x02.
